criteria.intent: Defined independent testing roles with bounded applicable execution
criteria.automated_scope: Guide bounds, existing mandatory routes and actual RI lookups establish mechanical discoverability only. Role semantics, risk selection, authorship independence and genuine non-applicability need independent inspection.

criteria.intent: Existing issue-to-PR flow consumes QA evidence and actionable GitHub Actions test design
criteria.automated_scope: Current catalog and CI coupling verify path/command integrity. They do not prove that scenario oracles reflect user intent or that actual QA work occurred.

criteria.intent: Discoverable bounded bilingual quality-agent routes with meaningful routing verification
criteria.automated_scope: Actual owner lookups and context CLI output exercise declared English/Ukrainian role and launch queries, instruction scope and existing check companions. No arbitrary-language or semantic-acceptance claim.

criteria.intent: Current-source checked, independently reviewed and normally incorporated bounded change
criteria.automated_scope: Basic, style, current navigation and coupling checks cover their existing subsets. Semantic style/scope review, unchanged runtime/public inspection, actual GitHub CI and main incorporation remain separate.

criteria.intent: Independent review of requirements and acceptance quality before implementation and at completion
criteria.automated_scope: Actual RI routes expose the requirements-quality owner. Mechanical checks cannot establish requirement necessity, clarity, completeness, consistency, feasibility, verifiability or traceability.

criteria.intent: Four actual separate completed source-bound agent executions for each coherent candidate
criteria.automated_scope: Navigation and bounds establish instruction access only. Distinct launches, independent source inspection, completion, nonauthorship, capability limitations and affected correction execution require actual external evidence.

REQUIREMENTS.description: Actual distinct nonauthoring Requirements & Acceptance Reviewer independently checks original issue/AC quality before dependent implementation, material requirement changes and completed candidate. Retain source-bound findings and intent-to-AC-to-check/evidence reconciliation; no invented maintainer decisions.

REVIEW.description: Actual separate nonimplementing Code Reviewer inspects the complete candidate/diff including tests, templates, policy and RI integration under each-iteration protocol. Recheck substantive corrections; inspect applicable CS01/04/05/08/09/10, unchanged runtime/public scope and role independence.

WHITEBOX.description: Actual distinct White-box QA independently inspects changed routing/design and tests, meaningful failure surfaces and oracle adequacy; records bounded test matrix, actual checks, source identity, findings and corrections. Cannot independently accept its own authored artifacts.

EXPLORATORY.description: Actual distinct Exploratory/Interaction QA independently exercises the changed RI/CLI surface from a bounded intent-based charter, recording candidate/environment/actions/observations and regression/manual dispositions. Missing evidence is not non-applicability or a physical-device claim.

LIVE.description: Fetch actual issue/PR/Refs commits, four independent role results and current-source CI; reconcile original ACs and actual issue checkboxes. Skipped Draft jobs or local reports do not establish remote admission.

MERGED.description: Applicable maintainer main-incorporation decision, successful existing staging/admission route and actual protected-main merge with source/tree identity verified before closure. No production publication requested.
